name: Transfix Monster
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level bard 6, inquisitor 6, mesmerist 6, sorcerer/wizard 6, summoner/unchained summoner 6, witch 6

DESCRIPTION

This functions as transfix person except it affects any living creature that fails its Will save.
